question: Which of the following countries hosted the largest yoga session with over 1.5 million participants in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India hosted the largest yoga session in 2025**, with over **1.5 million participants**, marking it as a historical event in the promotion of yoga and wellness globally.
 
• The event was organized on a massive scale to commemorate **International Yoga Day**, which is celebrated annually on **21st June** as declared by the United Nations in 2014.
 
• The location for the yoga session was a **sprawling venue** in India, specifically chosen to accommodate the large number of participants and to showcase the country's commitment to promoting yoga as a global practice.
 
• India has been at the forefront of promoting yoga worldwide, with efforts spearheaded by the Indian government, particularly under the leadership of **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**.
 
• The event set a **new Guinness World Record** for the largest yoga session, surpassing all previous records and drawing significant international attention.
